Today, I introduced the Ailani Myers AIM to Cure Kids With Cancer Act — a bill that would leverage AI to drive pediatric cancer breakthroughs.

The bill is named in honor of Ailani, a precious young cancer fighter who has fiercely advocated for the childhood cancer community. We owe it to children like her to provide the best possible treatments as we work toward beating this heartbreaking disease once and for all.
